scene_description: Light wood table with a lidded paperclip container on the right and a gray eraser at the front-left. A capped white marker lies behind them, partly hidden by the container. Front is the open table edge; left and right are as seen facing it.

targets.name: paperclip container
targets.description: Smoke-gray transparent paperclip container with a black lid and circular top opening, standing to the right of the gray eraser.
targets.clearance_notes: Front and sides are exposed, with open space overhead.
targets.other_notes: Contains loose paperclips; dimensions include the fitted lid.

targets.name: gray eraser
targets.description: Gray rectangular whiteboard eraser lying at the front-left of the paperclip container, in front of the marker cap.
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front and both long sides are exposed.

targets.name: white marker
targets.description: White dry-erase marker lying behind the eraser and paperclip container, with its black cap on the left and right end behind the container.
nearby_obstacles: Paperclip container in front of its right end
Gray eraser in front of its cap
targets.clearance_notes: Left cap and part of the barrel are exposed; the container limits front access to the right end.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the marker left into the open table area, clear of the container and eraser.
